areas.name: Mályvádi Őstölgyes
areas.note: Literal named nature-reserve footprint. The geographical name is already present as a point-only neighbourhood reference; no artificial urban subdivision is implied.

areas.name: Dénesmajor
areas.note: Union of actual detached residential parcels along the same village street fabric (Árvíz/Keszi/Solymos/Mályvádi/Gelvács streets). Public road gaps remain gaps. Adjacent farmyards and surrounding agricultural fields are excluded.

areas.name: Városerdő
areas.note: The two adjacent mapped residential surfaces of the detached Városerdő estate. The namepoint is8m outside the source residential boundary on its access street; no buffer is added merely to contain it.

areas.name: Mályvádi erdészkolónia
areas.note: The mapped small park/clearing at the namepoint and its nearby mapped forest-colony building. This is a coarse clearing-and-house search footprint, not the surrounding23.7km² forest and not an official whole-colony border.

areas.name: Csókáspuszta
areas.note: Actual farmyard footprint containing the same-name placepoint; this represents the built-up farmstead, not an invented broad hill/forest district.

areas.name: Ponyipuszta
areas.note: The immediately adjacent residential, industrial and farmyard source surfaces around the Ponyipuszta placepoint and Építők utca. Broader surrounding forest and separate Művésztelep/Felsőponyi areas are excluded.

areas.name: Batida
areas.note: Literal detached village residential footprint matched to the actual hamlet namepoint, rather than placing the schematic distant-village inset from the older KSH map.

areas.name: Szikáncs
areas.note: Literal detached village residential footprint matched to its actual hamlet namepoint. The same-name railway halt is excluded as a name control.
